style_when: the news is structural and abstract — a stack reordered, a layer added, a flow rerouted — and there is no literal object that carries it, so the idea is stated as a small physical assembly of recognisable parts rather than as bare shapes
prompt: Matte clay 3D render of a small mechanical assembly, studio render on a neutral seamless backdrop. A modular mechanical junction block with a single thick input routing into multiple diverging parallel output channels. Three recognizable engineered parts: a housing, a central distribution hub, and interlocking cable connectors. Matte surfaces with molding seams and soft contact shadows. Single soft key light, matte muted palette of soft gray and telecom orange. Generous negative space, clean editorial elegance.
negative_prompt: text, letters, numbers, wordmarks, signage, UI, bare geometric primitives, plain cubes, spheres, human hands, logos, complex backgrounds, messy wires
rationale: A matte clay render perfectly captures the abstract, structural nature of AI agent architecture by representing it as a tangible mechanical assembly, emphasizing the structural 'wiring' decision without distracting real-world branding.
subject: A modular mechanical junction block with diverging routing paths
alt_text: Modular mechanical junction block splitting one input into multiple parallel outputs in a matte clay style.
caption: The topology used to coordinate multiple AI agents drives the system's final operating cost and reliability.
title: Agent-Coordination-Topology-Clay
